screen.rationale: Primary study; PP face-mask filter fibres photo-oxidised by Fe3O4/Bi2O3/Ag microswarm under a 300 W Ultra-Vitalux lamp (UV-vis, passes E3), but outcomes are only SEM morphology, BET surface area/pore volume, FTIR carbonyl index (~26-fold), TGA onset shift and EDX oxygen wt%; no molar mass before/after and no quantified product (SPME-GC-MS by-products are qualitative and in SI).
